promises.quote: In response to points one and three, | understand that the records falsification and a number of key missing observations in Mr [name redacted] case for the afternoon he absconded from the ward, fell to one nurse, | am informed that the relevant individual was disciplined through Priory's internal processes and dismissed from employment. She was also referred to the NMC as her actions fell short of the standard required.
promises.summary: Discipline for falsification and missing observations

concerns.quote: There were repeated failures to perform basic nursing observations
There was a deliberate falsification of the nursing record

heard evidence that indicated an enduring situation where the ward frequently had inadequate numbers of staff with an inappropriate skill mix and with an inappropriate layout over two floors. There was a lack of discipline with staff failing to accept a nurse in charge's authority authority. Management was informed of some issues but failed to listen or act
The system of observations carried out within the unit, particularly at night is in need of reform

links.explanation: Both reports highlight failures in performing proper patient observations, especially regarding timing and documentation.
